headline: MIA @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.67 at PIT 4.91, with a projected total of 9.58. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (MIA +0.54, PIT +0.62), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.16, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Braxton Ashcraft has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Spencer Horwitz, Nick Gonzales, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Billy Cook, Owen Caissie because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
